verdict.rationale: Buzz documents headless agents that run on their own after deployment. Remote agents run on pluggable substrates such as Kubernetes, and the desktop keeps no control channel; you steer them only through the relay (buzz-supp-remote-agents). buzz-agent and buzz-dev-mcp are described as purpose-built for headless autonomous work, and Buzz also offers YAML-as-code workflow automation with traces plus CLI workflow trigger and approve commands (buzz-docs-13, buzz-docs-8, buzz-gh-2). missing for 10: detailed docs on workflow trigger types such as schedules or events and on background execution semantics, MCP-driven hooks evidenced only by a probe pointer, and independent hands-on corroboration of autonomous automations running.
